requiredResearchLayers.requirement: Locate and compare traditional source passages that directly discuss the theme,取用、世应/六亲观察、成败条件、动变关系、旺衰时效或相关断法. Record exact provenance and do not infer a formal rule from a legacy keyword heuristic alone.
Review later commentarial or systematizing works to identify stable interpretations, disputed interpretations, omitted conditions and school-specific extensions.

Review modern LiuYao authors and worked cases, including contemporary question forms, but treat modern practice as interpretive/reference evidence rather than automatic authority over classical sources.
For each proposed traditional rule, distinguish source consensus, compatible variants, real conflicts and unsupported extrapolation. Do not silently merge contradictory methods.
Translate only source-supported traditional conclusions into candidate observation rules. Keep modern-language semantic routing separate from traditional observation selection.

requiredOutputsPerTheme: main observation target plus supported secondary observations
collision analysis against current 22 routes and the other four new themes
open questions that remain unsupported by literature
research conclusion stating whether the theme is mature enough for Rule Registry design
